# VoxHearth 0.2.0

VoxHearth 0.2.0 bundles two fully local Parakeet Core ML speech models and lets
you choose between multilingual accuracy and a compact English mode for smaller
Apple silicon Macs.

Download `VoxHearth-v0.2.0.dmg`, verify `SHA256SUMS`, open the disk image, and
drag VoxHearth to Applications. This official artifact is Developer ID signed,
notarized, and stapled by Apple.
